data.gender_notes: Antonina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Antonios, which means 'priceless' or 'precious'. The feminine form, Antonina, is a beautiful name with deep Christian roots and biblical significance. In the New Testament, Antonina may be linked to St. Antonina, a noblewoman who provided shelter and support to St. Paul during his travels. Her name is synonymous with grace, generosity, and strength.
data.etymology: Antonina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, priceless one.”
